task: Option A companion fix: fail-closed data coverage at the window boundary

defect.summary: Staged ETHUSDT 15m bars ended 2026-08-20T02:29:59.999Z against a preregistered window ending 2026-08-21T00:00:00Z (86 bars / 21.5h short). research/panel.py build_daily_closes silently emitted a terminal daily close sourced from that stale bar, and coverage_report only counted it and raised nothing -- so a coverage shortfall propagated into the panel as if it were data.
defect.root_cause: Boundary resolution selected the last bar with ts_event <= C without checking that the bar is the LAST bar of the interval it feeds. With ts_event = bar CLOSE stamp, a daily close for boundary C is only legitimate if its sourcing bar falls in (C - 15m, C].

rule_implemented.statement: For a boundary/reference R, the sourcing bar must satisfy R - 15m < bar_ts <= R. Equivalently staleness_bars = (R - bar_ts) // 900_000_000_000 ns must be 0; >= 1 is a failure.
applies_to: build_daily_closes: EVERY day boundary in the window, not only the terminal one
coverage_report: every symbol WITH a non-empty series, against window_end
rule_implemented.exempt: A boundary with NO bar at-or-before it still emits nothing (warmup semantics preserved exactly, and never raises); a symbol with an empty series still reports 0 days and is exempt from the stale-tail raise.
rule_implemented.direction: backward-looking only: selection still resolves strictly backwards, so a later bar can never change an earlier day's close (PIT guarantee unchanged); the raise fires on the first stale boundary in ascending symbol/boundary order (deterministic).

exception.circular_import_note: Defined locally in research/panel.py. No import from research.adapter_v10: research/hyp_a8_m01 imports research.panel and research/adapter_v10/__init__ transitively imports M01, so a back-import would be circular.

api_changes.build_daily_closes: raises DataUnavailable on a stale sourcing bar at any boundary; docstring updated
api_changes.build_btc_benchmark: inherits the fix unchanged (same code path)
api_changes.coverage_report: raises DataUnavailable when a non-empty series' last close is older than window_end - 15m; NEW report key 'freshness' = {sym: {last_close_bar_ts: iso|None, staleness_bars: int|None, fresh: bool}}. All four pre-existing keys and their semantics unchanged.

new_helpers.staleness_bars: whole 15m intervals missing between a sourcing bar and a reference, exact integer arithmetic
new_helpers.iso_utc: epoch ns -> millisecond ISO-8601 UTC string, exact (no float round-trip)

blockers.cause: Every fixture writes exactly ONE bar per day at the 23:44:59.999Z slot (offset BAR_NS*95 - 1), i.e. 1 of 96 bars per day. Each boundary's newest bar at-or-before it is therefore 1 interval old and the new invariant correctly refuses it: DataUnavailable '... newest bar at-or-before it is 2025-08-18T23:44:59.999Z, 1 bar(s) (0.25h) stale ...'. The fixtures violate the production 15m-cadence invariant the fix enforces.
blockers.remedy_for_owner: Regenerate those fixtures with a full 96-bar day grid (terminal slot closing at 23:59:59.999Z); tests/test_panel_v10r.py::write_bars/grid is the reference fixture. Two of them (test_eth_trimmed_start_and_coverage_report, test_coverage_blocks_distinct_reason_code_inputs) additionally assert set(report) == {4 keys} and will also need the new 'freshness' key added to that expectation.

verified_not_affected.note: Indirect production callers of build_daily_closes were spot-checked (read-only) so the blocker list is complete; full-suite sweep remains A1's job.

new: 8 fail-closed regression pins on production-shaped 15m/PIT fixtures
